alternatives.option: Mock all stores and test assembler in isolation
alternatives.reason_rejected: Would miss integration issues between stores and assembler — the exact gap that caused low coordination lift

alternatives.option: Run full benchmark suite for feedback
alternatives.reason_rejected: Takes 23+ hours and costs hundreds of dollars — too slow for iteration

context: Benchmark results showed 92% tool engagement but near-zero coordination lift (d=0.01-0.14). Need fast-feedback tests (seconds, not hours) to measure whether assemble output is actionable and iterate on quality.
rationale: Real stores (BlackboardStore, DecisionStore, HandoffStore, AgentStore, GraphEngine) with temp dirs give accurate end-to-end coverage of the assemble pipeline. Only SearchEngine is null (no embeddings needed). This catches real integration issues that mocks would hide, while still running in ~1 second.
summary: Coordination effectiveness test suite using real stores with temp dirs, no mocking
